en.headline: Bangkok floods delay at least 21 Hong Kong flights
en.dek: Airport data cited by the South China Morning Post showed ten inbound and four outbound Hong Kong–Bangkok services delayed by an hour or more on Sunday.
body: At least 21 flights between Hong Kong and Bangkok were disrupted on Sunday and Monday after flooding in the Thai capital, the South China Morning Post reported, citing the Hong Kong airport website.

Ten inbound flights and four outbound flights on Sunday were delayed by at least an hour. One Hong Kong-bound service leaving Bangkok faced a delay of nearly 24 hours. Heavy rain from Thursday through Monday led Thai officials to declare Bangkok a disaster zone.

Bangkok is a frequent destination for Hong Kong travellers. Reports from the city said central tourist districts were less affected than some neighbourhoods, with shopping centres remaining open. Travellers were advised to check flight status and allow extra time on the roads to Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang airports, which remained open.

zh.headline: 曼谷水浸影響往來香港航班至少二十一班延誤
zh.dek: 傳媒引述機場資料，週日至少十班抵港及四班離港曼谷航班延誤一小時或以上，其中一班近二十四小時。
body: 泰國曼谷近日暴雨成災，往來香港與曼谷的航班週日及周一至少有二十一班受阻，《南華早報》引述香港機場網站資料報道。
週日有十班抵港及四班離港航班延誤至少一小時，其中一班由曼谷飛往香港的航班延誤接近二十四小時。曼谷周四至周一持續暴雨，當局宣布全市為災區。
曼谷是港人常到目的地。當地報道指市中心旅遊區受影響較部分社區為輕，商場仍然開放。兩個主要機場維持運作，旅客宜查核航班並預留額外時間前往機場。
